result:
Done.

**Root cause:** the transposition-table probe's depth guard in `variants/bug06/tt.inc` used `jr z,ttNoCut` instead of `jr c,ttNoCut`, so it rejected the one safe case (entry depth == current depth) and accepted every too-shallow entry — which made iteration 2 of iterative deepening expensive enough (652 frames) to blow the 468-frame clock budget, so iterations 3+ never started and every level ≥ 2 returned the depth-2 answer.

**Files touched (all in place):**
- `variants/bug06/tt.inc` — fix #1 (`jr z` → `jr c`); corrected stale 48K-geometry header comment and `ttStore`'s input contract
- `variants/bug06/engine.inc` — fix #2 at `ttfStore`: restamp `ttCurDepth` from the node's own per-ply depth (a global clobbered by every child probe was stamping 100% of entries depth 1, leaving fix #1's guard gating on a constant)
- `variants/bug06/Makefile` — `SRC` was missing `tt.inc`/`zobrist.inc`/`perft.inc`, so editing `tt.inc` shipped a stale tape; `make test` now runs the new check
- `variants/bug06/level_test.py` — new regression test
- `variants/bug06/chess.bin`, `chess.tap` — rebuilt
- `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md` — workspace root

**Gate status:**
- Reported symptom no longer reproduces — PASS. Endgame L2 f8f7/0, L3/L4/L5 d5e4/30; middlegame L2 d5g2/47, L5 d5g2/77; 48K and hc128 identical in all 30 cells.
- `make test` — PASS, 6/6 (~66 s).
- New test — PASS, deterministic. Proven load-bearing against 4 mutants: fix #1 reverted, levels 4/5 hard-wired to 3, fix #2 reverted (caught only by the white-box TT-STAMP check), and round 2's own restamp-from-`effDepth` mutant.
- Review — round 1 raised 3 valid blocking findings (vacuous L4/L5 test, the `ttStore` stamping defect, a wrong causal story), all fixed; round 2 returned **no blocking findings**, closing the gate at round 2 of 3.

**Knowingly left open** (recorded in `FIX_NOTES.md`, not required by the gate): levels 4 and 5 run no extra iterations in the two report positions because of the engine's clock pacing — this is the reference behaviour, positively demonstrated (with the clock gate removed, L4 gives `d5e4`/**0**, which would *not* match the report's expected table); the margin is thin (~5%), so late in a game the ladder shortens again; plus pre-existing items (`blackDepth` not in the save state, root-relative mate scores in the TT, 16-bit Zobrist key) and three `level_test.py` refinements round 2 suggested.
